story.headline: The trade king strikes again: Vin and Tom swap three for three
body: Stop the presses. **Vin**, the league's all-time trade leader, just closed **deal No. 20**. Nobody else has more than eight. It's the third Vin–Tom trade ever, and Tom's first since December 2021, when these same two swapped Drew Doughty for Artem Zub and Alex Nedeljkovic.

**Vin** gets **Will Cuylle** (93.9 FPts in 24 GP), Tom's seventh-round pick and a Will draftee a season ago, plus two old friends: **Rasmus Andersson**, Vin's own 17th-rounder last season, and **Sergei Bobrovsky**, whom Vin first traded for back in November 2019. Tom grabbed Bobrovsky in round 11 this fall.

**Tom** lands the hottest name in the deal, **Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen** (9.13 FP/G over the last 14 days). Vin drafted him, cut him in week 2 and claimed him back a week later. **Lucas Raymond**, a Will drop that Vin scooped up, comes too, and so does **Brayden McNabb**, whose stay with Vin lasted less than a month after the Werenski deal with Danny.

story.headline: Vin's 19th trade: Werenski for two
body: The phones were ringing. **Vin**, 12th at 1-4, makes the 19th trade of his career, still the most in the books. **Danny** (8th, 2-3) is on his second trade of the season, and it's the first between these two.
**Danny** gets **Zach Werenski**, Vin's 6th-round pick, and it's a reunion: Danny drafted him in round 7 in 2017-18. He has 40.4 points in 12 games.
**Vin** gets **Dylan Larkin**, a week-5 waiver claim by Danny, with 38.5 points in 10 games, and **Brayden McNabb**, Danny's 14th-round pick, with 40.9 from the blue line. Two for one, 79.4 to 40.4.

story.headline: The first trade of the Fantrax era
body: The first trade of 2026-27, and the first since the move to Fantrax. **Danny** and **Tim** are both 2-1: Danny 3rd, Tim 5th. It's their third trade together.
**Tim** gets **Stuart Skinner**, Danny's 22nd-round pick, with 30 points in 5 games, 6.0 a start.
**Danny** gets **Andrei Svechnikov**, Tim's 7th-rounder, and it's a reunion: Danny took him in round 1 in 2020-21. Svechnikov has 51.8 points in 10 games, 5.2 a night.

story.headline: Will's first trade: Kaprizov to Vin
body: **Will** makes his first trade on record, and it's a big one. **Kirill Kaprizov**, his third-round pick, goes to **Vin** (4th, 9-7). Will is 6th at 8-8.
**Vin** gets **Kaprizov**, with 164.3 points in 37 games (4.4 a game), and **Alexis Lafreniere**, Will's 9th-rounder, with 120.6. It's Vin's 18th trade in the books, the most of anyone.
**Will** gets **Matt Boldy**, Vin's 10th-round pick, with 172.4 in 52 games, and **Bryan Rust**, a 17th-rounder with 142.3. Rust is a reunion: Will drafted him in 2021-22. Will takes 314.7 to 284.9.

story.headline: Danny and Tim swap a goalie for Barzal
body: The playoff race is tight. **Danny** and **Tim** are both 9-8, 7th and 6th, and they make their second deal.
**Tim** gets **Joey Daccord**, a week-12 Danny pickup who has 202.4 points in 37 games, 5.5 a start.
**Danny** gets **Mathew Barzal**, Tim's 9th-round pick, with 176.9 points in 52 games. A goalie for a center, two teams on the bubble.

story.headline: Six players move, and Tkachuk is going back to Vin
body: A three-for-three in week 5. The reigning champion **Vin** (8th, 1-3) and **Joe** (11th, 1-3) both need a jolt. It's their second trade.

**Vin** gets **Matthew Tkachuk**, Joe's first-round pick, and it's a reunion: Vin traded for him in 2019-20 and drafted him in round 2 last season. Tkachuk has 40.8 points in 13 games. Goalie **Ilya Samsonov** (23.4) and **Victor Olofsson** (4.2) come too.

**Joe** gets **Bryan Rust** (49.3), goalie **Darcy Kuemper** (31.4) and **Lawson Crouse** (45.2), a week-4 Vin pickup. Two are reunions: Joe drafted Kuemper last season and Crouse the past two. Joe takes 125.9 to 68.4.

story.headline: Tim's first trade lands a goalie for the playoff push
body: A week-20 deal for the stretch run. **Tim**, 3rd at 13-6, makes his first trade on record. **Danny**, 7th at 9-10, is the partner.
**Danny** gets **Alexis Lafreniere**, Tim's 9th-round pick, with 150.2 points in 61 games.
**Tim** gets **Joonas Korpisalo**, a week-19 Danny pickup, with 142 points in 28 games, 5.1 a start. A contender buys a goalie for the playoffs.

story.headline: Vin and Zac make it six with a five-player deal
body: A five-player trade between **Vin** (4th, 8-4) and **Zac** (11th, 4-8), their sixth deal together.

**Vin** gets **Tom Wilson**, Zac's 6th-round pick, and it's a reunion: Vin drafted him in round 2 last season. Wilson has 131.5 points in 34 games. **John Klingberg**, a 12th-rounder with 59.7, comes too.

**Zac** gets **Cam Talbot**, Vin's 13th-round pick, and it's a reunion for him: Zac took Talbot in round 1 in 2017-18. Talbot has 146 points in 24 games. Two Vin pickups come along: **Dmitry Orlov** (99.4) and **Michael Bunting** (80.2).

story.headline: A Boxing Day deal: Doughty for two
body: A Boxing Day trade. The reigning champion **Vin** (4th, 7-3) and **Tom** (9th, 3-7) make their second deal.
**Vin** gets **Drew Doughty**, Tom's 9th-round pick, and it's a reunion: Vin drafted him in 2016-17. Doughty has 49.6 points in 11 games, 4.5 a game.
**Tom** gets two Vin pickups: goalie **Alex Nedeljkovic**, a week-5 add with 109.2 points in 21 games, and **Artem Zub**, a week-3 add with 75.8. On paper Tom takes the bigger total, 185 to 49.6.

story.headline: Taylor Hall comes back to Vin
body: The first trade of the shortened 2020-21 season. **Vin** sits 2nd at 4-1. **Zac** is 9th at 1-4. It's their fifth trade.
**Vin** gets **Taylor Hall**, Zac's 5th-round pick, and it's a reunion: Vin traded for him last season too. Hall has a slow 32.3 points in 16 games in Buffalo. A buy-low.
**Zac** gets **James van Riemsdyk**, a waiver claim by Vin in week 5, who is rolling: 63.5 points in 15 games, 4.2 a night.

story.headline: The first three-team trade in the books
body: Something new: a three-team deal. Three days after landing Stamkos, **Jefe** (2nd, 11-2) brings in **Zac** (8th, 6-7) and **Joe** (9th, 5-8) for four players.
**Jefe** gets **Dougie Hamilton**, Joe's 10th-round pick, with 178 points in 44 games, 4.0 a night, and **Casey Cizikas**, a week-9 Zac pickup with 149.8.
**Zac** gets **Mark Stone**, Jefe's 5th-rounder, and it's a reunion: Zac drafted him the past two seasons. Stone has 145.9 points. **Joe** gets **Brady Tkachuk**, Jefe's 8th-round pick, with 157.9.

story.headline: Jefe gets Stamkos for three
body: The reigning champion is loading up. **Jefe**, 2nd at 11-2, sends three players to **Palagi** (6th, 7-6) for two, headlined by Palagi's first-round pick, **Steven Stamkos**.
**Jefe** gets **Stamkos**, a first-round pick for the fifth time in seven drafts in the books, with 165 points in 39 games (4.2 a game), and **Anders Lee**, Palagi's 12th-rounder, with 129.6.

**Palagi** gets **Jordan Staal** (140.1), **Tomas Hertl** (Jefe's 4th-rounder, 126.1) and **Jakob Chychrun** (115). Staal was a week-12 pickup and Chychrun one from week 10. Three for two: 381.2 points to 294.6.

story.headline: Vin and Nick make it five
body: Trade No. 5 between **Vin** and **Nick**, still the busiest pair in the books. Both are 7-5: Nick 3rd, Vin 6th.
**Nick** gets two Vin pickups: goalie **Mackenzie Blackwood**, a week-6 add with 156 points in 32 games, and **Alex Tuch**, a week-9 add with 51.5.
**Vin** gets **Matthew Tkachuk**, Nick's 8th-round pick, with 131 points in 42 games, 3.1 a night. One star forward for a starting goalie and a depth piece.

story.headline: Six players and a first-rounder: Vin and Zac go big
body: The first trade of 2019-20 is a three-for-three, and the biggest in Vin and Zac's history together. It's their fourth deal. Both teams are 2-3: **Vin** 8th, **Zac** 11th.

**Vin** gets **Taylor Hall**, Zac's first-round pick, off to a slow 40.6-point start in 19 games, **Sergei Bobrovsky**, Zac's second-rounder (64.8 in 17), and **Ryan Ellis**, a 15th-rounder with 68.5. It's a buy-low on two early picks.

**Zac** gets **Connor Hellebuyck**, Vin's 4th-round pick, at 6.7 a start (106.6 in 16), plus two Vin pickups: **James Neal** (55.5) and **Bryan Rust** (43.6 in just 9 games). Zac takes 205.7 to 173.9.

story.headline: Contenders swap a goalie for Pastrnak
body: Two contenders make a deal: **Danny** is 2nd at 10-4, **Jefe** 4th at 9-5, and it's the first trade between them.
**Jefe** gets **Jacob Markstrom**, a week-10 Danny pickup who has 187 points in 35 games, 5.3 a start. Zac traded for him last season.
**Danny** gets **David Pastrnak**, Jefe's 4th-round pick, with 180 points in 48 games. Pastrnak went to Will in round 3 last season. Nearly even on paper: 187 to 180.

story.headline: Three days later, the champ deals again
body: **Palagi** (6th, 7-6) isn't done. Three days after moving Kopitar, the reigning champ makes a one-for-one with **Tom** (9th, 5-8).
**Tom** gets **Colton Sissons**, Palagi's 6th-round pick, with 125.2 points in 37 games, 3.4 a night.
**Palagi** gets **David Krejci**, Tom's 13th-rounder, with 111.2 points in 42 games. Tom has drafted him three times in the books, and he lets him go anyway.

story.headline: The champ gives up a first-rounder: Kopitar to Jefe
body: The reigning champion is dealing. **Palagi** (6th, 6-6) moves **Anze Kopitar**, his first-round pick, to **Jefe** (4th, 8-4) in a two-for-two.
**Jefe** gets **Kopitar**, and it's a reunion: Jefe took him in round 2 in 2016-17. He has 145.4 points in 41 games. **Austin Watson**, a week-9 Palagi pickup with 72.5, comes too.
**Palagi** gets **Ryan Nugent-Hopkins**, Jefe's 10th-round pick, with 125.3 points, and **Ian Cole**, a week-4 Jefe add on defense, with 106.5. A slight edge to Palagi on paper: 231.8 to 217.9.

story.headline: Josi heads back to Vin, again
body: **Vin** (9th, 3-5) and **Zac** (2nd, 6-2) make their third trade, and once again **Roman Josi** is going to Vin. Last season Vin got him from Zac. This season Zac drafted him in round 5.
**Vin** gets **Josi**, with 80.5 points in 30 games, and **Mikael Granlund**, Zac's 6th-round pick, with 92.4 in 29.

**Zac** gets two week-8 Vin pickups: **Mikko Koskinen**, who has been lights-out in goal at 6.7 a start (86.8 in 13 games), and **Max Pacioretty**, with 72.4. That's 172.9 to 159.2, but Koskinen's rate is the number to watch.

story.headline: League leader Danny makes his first trade
body: **Danny**, the champion of 2013-14 and 1st again at 4-1, makes his first trade in the books. **Tom** (10th, 2-3) is on his second, 11 days after his first.
**Danny** gets **T.J. Oshie**, Tom's 6th-round pick (Tom drafted him in 2014-15 and 2016-17 too), with 77.9 points in 18 games, 4.3 a night.
**Tom** gets two: **Ryan Getzlaf**, Danny's 10th-rounder, with 66 points in 15 games (4.4 a game), and **Brendan Gallagher**, Danny's 17th-round pick, with 62.3. Two for one: 128.3 to 77.9.

story.headline: Vin and Nick, part four
body: Trade No. 4 between these two, the most of any pair in the books. **Nick** is 2nd at 4-1. **Vin**, 1-4 and 11th, makes his third trade in four weeks.
**Vin** gets **Evander Kane**, Nick's third-round pick, with 54.2 points in 20 games.
**Nick** gets **Zach Parise**, a week-2 Vin pickup, and it's a reunion: Nick took him in round 16 last season. Parise has 67.8 points in 18 games, 3.8 a game.

story.headline: Tom's first trade brings Big Buff back to Vin
body: Two 1-3 teams. **Tom**, 11th, makes the first trade of his career, and **Vin**, 10th, makes his ninth.
**Vin** gets **Dustin Byfuglien**, Tom's third-round pick, and it's a reunion: Vin traded for Big Buff last season. He has 47.5 points in 12 games, 4.0 a night.
**Tom** gets two: goalie **Jack Campbell**, a week-4 Vin pickup with 47.8 points in 10 games, and **Jacob Trouba**, Vin's 14th-rounder, with 38 from the blue line.

story.headline: Jefe makes his first trade in week 2
body: One week into 2018-19, and **Jefe** makes his first trade on record. Both teams are 0-1. The partner, of course, is **Vin**, now on career trade No. 8.
**Vin** gets **Blake Wheeler**, Jefe's second-round pick (a Tim favorite in past drafts), off to a slow start with 19.5 points in 8 games, plus **Erik Haula**, Jefe's 16th-rounder, at 9.9.

**Jefe** gets two hot starts: **Micheal Ferland**, a week-1 Vin pickup with 41 points in 8 games, and **Mathew Dumba**, Vin's 9th-rounder, with 35. It's 76 to 29.4 on the season so far, a classic buy-low for Vin.

story.headline: Vin moves Draisaitl in a four-player deal
body: Vin's seventh trade in the books, the most of anyone, and it's a big one: **Leon Draisaitl**, his second-round pick, is on the move. **Vin** is 14-2 and 1st. **Joe** is 9th at 6-10.
**Vin** gets **Ryan McDonagh**, Joe's 9th-round pick, with 137 points from the blue line, and **Jaden Schwartz**, a 15th-rounder with 133.4 in 37 games (3.6 a game).
**Joe** gets **Draisaitl**, with 160.1 points in 50 games, plus **Adam Larsson**, Vin's 5th-rounder, with 127.5 (Vin drafted him last season too). Joe takes back more points today, 287.6 to 270.4.

story.headline: Vin flips Keith 20 days after getting him
body: **Vin** is 13-2 and still dealing: his sixth career trade, which ties Nick for the most in the books. **Ronnie** (11th, 5-10) is the partner.

**Ronnie** gets **Duncan Keith**, who came to Vin from Zac just 20 days ago, with 80 points in 49 games, plus **Carter Hutton**, a week-13 Vin pickup in goal. Hutton has 135.4 points in only 21 games, 6.4 a start.
**Vin** gets **Dustin Byfuglien**, Ronnie's 5th-round pick, with 113 points in 38 games, and **Sebastian Aho**, Ronnie's 13th-rounder, with 102.2. Almost dead even: 215.4 to 215.2.

story.headline: Nick deals again, four days later
body: Four days after his last deal, **Nick** (2nd, 10-4) is back at it, this time with **Palagi** (6th, 7-7). It's Nick's sixth trade in the books, the most of anyone.
**Palagi** gets **Brandon Montour**, a week-3 Nick pickup on the blue line with 109 points in 45 games.

**Nick** gets two: **Tyler Toffoli**, a week-9 Palagi add (Palagi also drafted him in 2015-16) with 107.1, and **Kevin Shattenkirk**, Palagi's 10th-rounder, with 86.5. Two for one, 193.6 points to 109.

story.headline: Zac's third deal in 10 days lands a goalie
body: **Zac** is working the phones: his third trade in 10 days. This time it's with **Nick**, who sits 2nd at 10-4 while Zac is 12th at 2-12.
**Zac** gets **Jacob Markstrom**, a week-8 Nick pickup who has 148.8 points in 33 games, 4.5 a start.
**Nick** gets **Boone Jenner**, a week-12 Zac add with 110.5 points in 39 games. Joe drafted him in round 6 last season. A contender adds forward depth and gives up a goalie to do it.

story.headline: Two days later, Vin and Zac go again
body: The ink is barely dry. Two days after their first deal, **Vin** (1st, 11-2) and **Zac** (12th, 2-11) swap defensemen.
**Vin** gets **Roman Josi**, Zac's 4th-round pick, and it's another reunion: Vin drafted him in 2015-16. Josi has 102 points in 38 games.
**Zac** gets **Zach Werenski**, a week-9 Vin pickup with 87.5 points in 39 games. He's younger, a little behind Josi on points, and Zac is building for the long haul.

story.headline: Zac's first trade: 2-10 deals with the 11-1 leader
body: The top of the table and the bottom of it. **Vin** is 11-1. **Zac**, in his first season, is 2-10, and he makes his first-ever trade with the league leader.

**Vin** gets **Henrik Zetterberg**, a week-11 Zac pickup with 103.4 points in 40 games (Ronnie drafted him three seasons running), and **Duncan Keith**, Zac's 8th-round pick, with 64.5 from the blue line.
**Zac** gets two of Vin's week-12 adds: **Calle Jarnkrok** (101.3 points, 2.5 a game) and **Torey Krug** (69). The totals are dead even, 170.3 to 167.9, a fair swap for a team trying to climb.

story.headline: Simmonds goes back to Vin
body: **Vin** and **Nick** are at it again: trade No. 3 between them, and the first of 2017-18. Vin leads the league at 4-1. Nick is 8th at 2-3.
**Vin** gets **Wayne Simmonds**, Nick's second-round pick, and it's a reunion: Vin drafted him in 2014-15 and 2015-16. Simmonds has 54.6 points in 19 games so far.
**Nick** gets **Sean Couturier**, a week-3 pickup off the wire who has been one of the better finds of the young season: 86.1 points in 19 games, 4.5 a night. Nick takes the bigger number today.

story.headline: Sid the Kid is on the move
body: A week-19 blockbuster. **Sidney Crosby**, a first-round pick in every season in the books, changes hands, and it's the first trade for both **Joe** (4th, 11-7) and the reigning champion **Palagi** (8th, 8-10).
**Joe** gets goalie **John Gibson**, Palagi's 4th-round pick, for the stretch run. Gibson has 269 points in 48 games, 5.6 a start, as Joe locks in for a playoff push.

**Palagi** gets **Crosby**, Joe's No. 2 overall pick, with 284.4 points in 57 games (5.0 a game). He went in round 1 to Jefe in 2013-14, Ronnie in 2014-15 and Steve last season. The champ is two games under .500 and needs a spark.

story.headline: New Year's Eve deal: first place meets 0-10
body: Ringing out 2016 with a trade. **Vin** sits 1st at 8-2. **Nick** is 0-10 and still looking for his first win. They swap two for two, their second deal together.

**Vin** lands **Patrice Bergeron**, Nick's first-round pick and an old Nick favorite (round 2 in 2013-14, round 3 the year after). Bergeron has 100.1 points in 35 games. **Cal Clutterbuck**, a 16th-rounder with 95.7, rounds it out.

**Nick** gets **Steve Mason**, a week-5 pickup in goal at 4.5 points a start (140.6 in 31), and **Milan Lucic**, Vin's 5th-round pick, with 105.4. Nick takes back 246 points to Vin's 195.8. Win No. 1 could be next.

story.headline: Vin's first trade brings Getzlaf home
body: Stop the presses: **Vin** has made a trade. It's his first, and the first of 2015-16, and he goes after a first-round pick to do it. **Nick** (8th, 5-8) moves **Ryan Getzlaf** to the 5th-place 8-5 squad.

**Vin** knows Getzlaf well: he drafted him in round 4 in 2013-14 and in round 1 last season. Getzlaf has 110 points in 37 games. **Andrei Markov**, Nick's 10th-rounder, comes along with 87.5 points from the back end.

**Nick** gets **Mike Hoffman**, a week-8 pickup who has quietly piled up 114.7 points (2.9 a game), and **Dion Phaneuf**, Vin's 16th-round pick, with 101. It's Nick's second trade on record, and he takes back the bigger total, 215.7 to 197.5.

story.headline: Trade No. 1 in the books: Ronnie and Nick get it started
body: Somebody had to go first. Five weeks into 2013-14, the first season in the RRDJ record books, **Ronnie** (8th, 2-2) and **Nick** (9th, 1-3) open the trade ledger with a two-for-two.

**Ronnie** takes **Bryan Little**, Nick's 15th-round pick, who has 77.9 points in 17 games (4.6 a night), plus **Matt Niskanen**, a week-1 pickup with 52 points from the blue line. That's the bigger haul on paper: 129.9 points so far.

**Nick** gets a goalie in **Semyon Varlamov**, Ronnie's 15th-rounder, at 4.8 points a start (48.1 in 10 games), and **Mason Raymond**, another week-1 add with 39.4. At 1-3, Nick is betting a netminder turns the season around.
